event_window.overlap: Keep earliest event of the same type; reject later events within 30 ticks. Recovery is censored at the next event of either random type and at window end; bounce curves retain overlaps with other event types.

common_diagnostics.scope: Reuse the previously frozen common physical states; no new holdout access

behavior_selection: Lexicographically first scenario/source-model/tick on A10 state with observable speed 2 where A14 chooses medium and A10 chooses another action.
First accepted target bounce where own-rollout pre-action alignment recovery differs within the next 30 ticks; same-type events suppressed within 30 ticks.
First same-state medium disagreement where A14 own-route post-distance exceeds A10 own-route distance. Save absence when none; this is descriptive, not a causal one-step counterfactual.
planning.event_overlap: Reuse prior accepted-event rules for distance/recovery curves; alignment recovery uses first d_pre=0 within 30 ticks after a bounce, window-censored.
planning.bootstrap: Resample whole paired scenarios, and for Hybrid resample the five paired source models independently; same scenario draw across all models. Percentile 95% intervals. Never resample ticks.

extra_metrics.first_close: First post-motion d<=1, 1-based; no acquisition assigned 300, acquired flag retained.
extra_metrics.phases: Acquisition includes first close tick; sustained tracking is strictly after first close, or empty if never close.
extra_metrics.boundary: Any of four pre-action cursor/target coordinates within 3 cells inclusive of an edge.
extra_metrics.overshoot: Cursor crosses current target coordinate on its exact row/column before target motion.
extra_metrics.reversal: Consecutive cursor commands along same axis with opposite sign; descriptive.
extra_metrics.medium: IDs 10..13, nominal L1=2; actual L1 from clipping separately 0/1/2.
